tips.title: Open a part file and assign a machine definition
tips.body: Start Mastercam, select the default metric configuration file, open the part file 'single_contour.mcam', and choose a wire EDM machine definition.

tips.title: Create a contour toolpath with a single contour
tips.body: On the Wireframe tab, choose Point Position and identify the thread point on the gear shape. Create a point at X-40, Y0.2, Z0.

tips.title: Define stock model for better visualization
tips.body: In the Toolpaths Manager, set stock boundaries with Y75, X75, Z10 and a Z origin of 10.

tips.title: Select geometry for toolpaths (chaining)
tips.body: On the Wirepaths tab, choose Contour and chain the thread point with the gear shape.

tips.title: Enter wire path parameters
tips.body: Set Wire Diameter to 0.2, Compensation Type to Computer, and Taper settings for Rapid height, UV trimplane, and UV height.

tips.title: Backplot the toolpath to check for errors
tips.body: Click Backplot selected operations, display wire and guides during backplot, run the backplot, and exit.

tips.title: Change toolpath parameters for better machining
tips.body: Modify parameters and update the operation to include new settings for more effective machining.

tips.title: Set Wire Overburn for Passes
Add Additional Skim Cuts
tips.body: Enter 3 for additional skim cuts before tab to improve finish.

tips.title: Set Tab Width and Cutting Method
tips.body: Tab Width: 1.0; Cutting Method: Reverse

tips.title: Select Glue Stop for Output
tips.body: Choose a glue stop to pause machine before tab cut.

tips.title: Set Lead-in and Lead-out Motion
tips.body: Use arc motion with radius 0.125 and sweep 60 for entry and exit moves.

tips.title: Set Maximum Leadout Distance
tips.body: Distance: 0.3 to shorten leadout move.

tips.title: Postprocess Toolpath to NC Code
tips.body: Use postprocessor to convert Mastercam file to G-code.

tips.title: Select Multiple Contours for Wire EDM
tips.body: Use window chaining to select multiple contours.

tips.title: Set Tab Width for Multiple Contours
tips.body: Tab Width: 2.0 to keep part from dropping out of stock.

tips.title: Set Compensation for Multiple Contours
tips.body: Compensation Type: Computer; Direction: Left

tips.title: Add Glue Stops for Multiple Contours
tips.body: Select 'Foreach tab' to add glue stops before each tab cut.

tips.title: Set Lead-in and Lead-out Motion for Multiple Contours
tips.body: Use arc motion with radius 0.5 and sweep 90 for entry and exit moves.

tips.title: Set Overlap for Multiple Contours
tips.body: Overlap: 0.02 to eliminate potential burrs.

tips.title: Set Taper for Multiple Contours
tips.body: Rapid Height: 20.0; UV Trim Plane: UV; UV Height: 20.0

tips.title: Adjust Chain Order for Multiple Contours
tips.body: Sort chains from Y+X to get desired toolpath motion.

tips.title: Verify selected operations in Toolpaths Manager
tips.body: Click 'Verify' at the top of the Toolpaths Manager to display stock, wire, and guides in the Mastercam Simulator window.

tips.title: Rotate view in Simulator window
tips.body: Right-click in the Simulator window and choose 'Isometric' then 'Fit' to get a better view of the toolpath and wire.

tips.title: Play through verification in Simulator window
tips.body: Click 'Play' at the bottom of the Simulator window to move through the verification process.

tips.title: Zoom in on results in Simulator window
tips.body: After verification, right-click and choose 'Zoom Window' to draw a window around the center part to look at the results more closely.

tips.title: Remove chips and observe slug dropout
tips.body: Click 'Remove Chips' on the Verify tab, then click on the middle part to see the slug dropout of the stock.

tips.title: Select thread points for NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: On the Wireframe tab, choose 'Point Position' and select 'Thread Point'. Move cursor to end of a slot to detect center of an arc.

tips.title: Define thread points for NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: Select four points as thread points, placing them close together to reduce travel time between slots.

tips.title: Set up stock for NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: In the Toolpaths Manager, set stock shape to Cylindrical with Axis Z and dimensions 30 height and 40 diameter.

tips.title: Select geometry for NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: All chains (except thread points) must be a closed shape for NoCore toolpaths.

tips.title: Set up NoCore toolpaths parameters
tips.body: Select 'Rapid', 'UVtrimplane', and 'UVheight' to 40.0 for the NoCore toolpath.

tips.title: Select cutting method for NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: The default Parallel Spiral option works well for this part.

tips.title: Enable finish pass for NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: Select 'Finish' and enable it to activate the default finish pass parameters.

tips.title: Set compensation type for finish pass
tips.body: Select 'Compensation Type' to compute for the finish pass.

tips.title: Set start pass option for finish pass
tips.body: Select 'Startpass at closest entity' to make the toolpath motion more efficient.

tips.title: Backplot NoCore toolpaths
tips.body: Click 'Backplot' and select 'Quick verify' to display a shaded path the width of the wire as backplot progresses.

tips.title: Select a different machine definition for 4-axis toolpaths
tips.body: On the Machinetab, choose 'Wire' and manage list to select a different machine definition than the default Wire machine.

tips.title: Add a Makino machine definition for 4-axis toolpaths
tips.body: Select 'GENERIC MAKINO 4X WIREMM (Tech).MCAM-WMD' from the machine definition list and click Add.

tips.title: Set up stock for 4-axis toolpaths
tips.body: In the Toolpaths Manager, set stock shape to Cylindrical with Axis Z and dimensions 40 height and 70 diameter.

tips.title: Select geometry for 4-axis toolpaths
tips.body: Change geometry in two planes: XY plane (lower contour) and UV plane (upper contour).

tips.title: Chain geometry for 4-axis toolpaths
tips.body: Select thread point to the left of the part as the first toolpath chain and chain the upper contour starting at the green point.

tips.title: Select synchronization method for 4-axis toolpaths
tips.body: Select 'By Entity' from the Sync mode drop-down list to match endpoints of each entity.

tips.title: Set up parameters for 4-axis toolpaths
tips.body: Select 'Wire/Power' and click the Tech button to change power settings for this toolpath.
